name: Sebastianus
original_name: 聖骨のセバスティアヌス
source:
Ira's true identity is Sebastianus of the Holy Bone, an apostle of Index, a serious warrior. In 1945, he lost his life trying to commit a double suicide with the witch Lieselotte Werckmeister, but failed. 
Sebastianus was resurrected as Ira, remembering nothing but his mission to protect the seal. 

[Edited from the [url=http://11eyes.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]11eyes wiki[/url].]
